At 1KOMMA5° , we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free . To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?
We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated.

This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.
Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.
Learn about our Product & Tech team!
Deine Position
As Product Manager Procurement & Portfolio Management, you take on one of the most strategically defining product roles within our energy retail business: you design how 1KOMMA5° procures, hedges, and optimizes electricity for an increasingly flexible customer portfolio. You sit at the intersection of energy markets, energy procurement, our flexibility assets, and our customer-facing tariff strategy - and you turn this into a measurable commercial advantage.
Own our Procurement Strategy: Define how and where 1KOMMA5° procures energy for our customer portfolio - across day-ahead, intraday, and forward markets. Develop a clear market split logic, and continuously refine it based on portfolio characteristics, customer mix, and market conditions.
Design Portfolio Hedging & Risk Management: Build hedging and risk management strategies tailored to different customer portfolios (dynamic vs fixed tariffs or flexibility/ancillary services). Define when and how we lock in volumes, what we leave open, and how we balance commercial upside against risk exposure.
Shape Our Flexibility Procurement Model: Design how we procure and steer our flexibility portfolio. Defining models such as flexibility bands, fixed volumes, strike-price-based offers, and the trade-offs between them. Develop the commercial logic and the operational requirements for each model.
Run Quantitative Portfolio Analysis: Independently run analyses on procurement performance, hedging effectiveness, and portfolio economics. Build the analytical foundation that supports strategic decisions, identifies optimization opportunities, and quantifies the impact of changes to our procurement and steering setup.
Monitor Performance and Drive Continuous Improvement: Define KPIs across procurement cost, hedge effectiveness, portfolio risk, and flexibility margin. Use data to continuously sharpen our market positioning and commercial performance.
Dein Profil

4+ years of experience in (international) energy procurement, portfolio management, or energy trading, ideally in a utility, energy retailer, trading desk, or aggregator environment
Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience running portfolio analyses, hedge calculations, and market scenarios (Python, SQL, or comparable tools are a strong plus)
Proven ability to translate market and commercial logic into structured processes and product requirements
Entrepreneurial, proactive, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-moving market environment
Excellent written and spoken English and German

Deep understanding of European power markets - day-ahead, intraday, and forward markets - and the mechanisms that drive prices
Solid working knowledge of hedging instruments (futures, options, OTC), balancing markets, and BRP settlement
Familiarity with flexibility products and procurement models (flexibility bands, fixed volumes, strike-price offers) and their commercial trade-offs
Awareness of regulatory frameworks shaping energy retail (Marktkommunikationsprozesse, balancing regimes, market design developments)
Experience working with external procurement partners, ETRM systems, or trading platforms is a strong plus

You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe's most thriving scaleups
You can work in one of our offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass

At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world. ​ Job Overview Product Manager – OTB Solutions Job Overview & Opportunity At TE Connectivity , our Product Management teams help shape the technologies that enable the world's most advanced AI, cloud, and networking infrastructure.

The Product Manager – OTB Solutions will lead a portfolio of high-speed datacenter interconnect products and help drive strategy, innovation, commercialization, and lifecycle management across a growing global business.

This role combines strategic thinking, customer engagement, business leadership, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver solutions that address evolving customer and market needs.

The successful candidate will partner closely with Sales, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Marketing, and customers to translate market opportunities into profitable growth and successful product outcomes.

This role offers broad visibility across the organization and the opportunity to influence product strategy, investment priorities, and customer success. Why This Role Matters OTB products play an important role in enabling next-generation AI and cloud infrastructure.

In this position, you will help shape technologies that support some of the world's most innovative datacenter platforms while working alongside customers, ecosystem partners, and technology leaders across the industry.

This opportunity provides meaningful exposure to portfolio strategy, new product development, commercial execution, and customer engagement in a highly collaborative environment. Short Description Key Responsibilities Portfolio Strategy & Market Insight
· Develop product and portfolio strategies aligned with customer needs, technology trends, and business priorities.
· Monitor market developments, competitive activity, and emerging opportunities.
· Contribute to product roadmaps and investment decisions that support long-term growth.
· Help define compelling value propositions and market positioning. Business & Commercial Leadership
· Support achievement of revenue, profitability, and market growth objectives.
· Develop business cases, financial analyses, and portfolio recommendations.
· Partner with Sales, Finance, Operations, and Engineering to align business plans and execution priorities.
· Contribute to pricing, commercial strategy, and customer engagement activities. New Product Development & Customer Engagement
· Lead commercialization efforts for new product initiatives from concept through launch.
· Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure solutions meet customer, quality, and operational requirements.
· Engage directly with customers to understand challenges, identify opportunities, and support design-win activity.
· Help drive successful execution of strategic development programs. Product Lifecycle Management
· Support portfolio optimization and continuous improvement initiatives.
· Partner with teams to address product, quality, delivery, and customer-related challenges.
· Contribute to forecasting, demand planning, and inventory management activities.
· Enable commercial success through customer-facing communications, training, and sales support. What Success Looks Like Success in this role is demonstrated through:
· Strong portfolio business performance
· Successful execution of new product introductions
· Improved customer engagement and design-win growth
· Effective cross-functional collaboration
· Delivery of profitability, operational, and business objectives
· Continuous learning, team contribution, and leadership influence What your background should look like: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Experience in product management, engineering, sales, field applications, business management, or a related role within a technology-focused environment. Experience supporting new product development, commercialization, or product lifecycle activities. Strong analytical, business, and problem-solving skills. Ability to influence and collaborate across cross-functional teams. Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills. Preferred Qualifications
· Experience in datacenter infrastructure, AI systems, networking, interconnects, connectors, cables, sockets, or related technologies.
· Experience working with hyperscalers, OEMs, ODMs, silicon providers, or other strategic technology customers.
· Knowledge of portfolio management, pricing strategy, business planning, or financial analysis.
· Understanding of high-speed interconnect technologies and datacenter architectures.
· MBA and advanced technical degree, or equivalent relevant experience. Competencies Motivating Others Building Effective Teams Managing and Measuring Work Values: Integrity, Accountability, Inclusion, Innovation, Teamwork SET : Strategy, Execution, Talent (for managers) ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more. Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com and on LinkedIn , Facebook , WeChat, Instagram and X (formerly Twitter). COMPENSATION

Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel.
Wir suchen keinen klassischen Finance-Experten. Wir suchen jemanden, der komplexe Prozesse versteht, gerne analytisch arbeitet und Spaß daran hat, gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen und Entwicklern intelligente Lösungen zu entwickeln.
Wenn Du Geschäftsprozesse lieber neu denkst als verwaltest und Daten für Dich mehr sind als Tabellen, solltest Du weiterlesen.
Deine Mission
Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Business, Technology und Data.
Gemeinsam mit Finance, Business Intelligence, Engineering und unseren Softwarepartnern entwickelst Du unsere Business-Systeme rund um Payments und Revenue kontinuierlich weiter. Dabei sorgst Du dafür, dass Prozesse einfacher, intelligenter und stärker automatisiert werden und wir jederzeit auf verlässliche Daten und Kennzahlen vertrauen können.
Das erwartet Dich
Prozesse gestalten statt verwalten
Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse, hinterfragst etablierte Abläufe und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen effizientere, skalierbare und automatisierte Lösungen.
Business und Technologie verbinden
Du verstehst fachliche Anforderungen, entwickelst daraus Lösungskonzepte und stimmst deren Umsetzung mit unseren Engineering-Teams und externen Softwarepartnern ab.
Daten intelligent nutzen
Gemeinsam mit unserem BI-Team entwickelst Du KPIs, Reports und Dashboards. Wenn Du Freude daran hast, erstellst Du Analysen auch selbst – beispielsweise mit BigQuery oder Tableau.
Automatisierung vorantreiben
Du identifizierst manuelle Abläufe, entwickelst Automatisierungskonzepte und begleitest deren Umsetzung.
Fraud bekämpfen
Du entwickelst unsere Prozesse zur Fraud Detection & Prevention kontinuierlich weiter und nutzt Datenanalysen, um Risiken frühzeitig zu erkennen.
Business-Plattformen weiterentwickeln
Du arbeitest an Themen wie Payments, Billing, Partnerabrechnung, Revenue Reporting, Datenqualität und Prozessautomatisierung und entwickelst unsere Systemlandschaft kontinuierlich weiter.

gerne komplexe Zusammenhänge verstehst und vereinfachst
technische Lösungen schnell durchdringst und Dich mit Entwicklern auf Augenhöhe austauschen kannst
analytisch denkst und Entscheidungen gerne auf Basis von Daten triffst
Prozesse hinterfragst und Freude daran hast, bessere Lösungen zu entwickeln
strukturiert arbeitest, Verantwortung übernimmst und Themen eigenständig vorantreibst
Menschen zusammenbringst und unterschiedliche Interessen erfolgreich koordinierst

Der Unterschied zu anderen "Digitalkanzleien": Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen - und damit, wie KI-gestützte Steuerberatung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird. Dein Steuerwissen prägt das Produkt, nicht nur dessen Anwendung.
Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €. Mit dir gemeinsam möchten wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen.
Deine Mission
KI-Features liefern, die Zahlen bewegen: Du verantwortest KI-Features end-to-end – Belegerkennung, Klassifizierung, automatisches Verfassen von Steuer-Antwortschreiben, RAG über Mandantenakten. Du baust die Eval-Frameworks, fährst die Prompt-Iterationen und triffst die Build-vs-Buy-Entscheidungen zu Modellen und Tooling. Keine Übergaben, keine Ausreden.
Werde besessen vom Nutzer: Du betreibst Discovery auf die harte Tour: Interviews, Shadowing-Sessions, Synthese von Rohfeedback. Du gehst tief genug, um echte von angenommenen Problemen zu unterscheiden – und wirst zur schärfsten Stimme des Nutzers in deiner Produktlinie.
Verantworte die Roadmap, verteidige die Trade-offs: Du verantwortest die Roadmap deiner Produktlinie end-to-end. Priorisierung über Geschäftswert, technische Machbarkeit und regulatorische Passung. Du kommunizierst Trade-offs klar an Engineering, Steuerberatung und Gründer – und verteidigst deine Entscheidungen mit Daten.
Halte die Messlatte beim Design: Du setzt einen hohen visuellen Standard und schützt ihn. Figma-Souveränität auf Review- und Skizzen-Niveau: Du entwirfst Flows, kritisierst Komponenten und blockst alles ab, was den Standard nicht erfüllt. Die beste Steuer-UX ist unsichtbar – mach unsere unsichtbar.
Laufe auf Daten, nicht auf Bauchgefühl: Du definierst die KPIs, die zählen – Time-to-Filing, Automatisierungsrate, Mandantenzufriedenheit, Berater-Effizienz – und steuerst jede Iteration aus Dashboards. Bauchgefühl bringt hier keine Features in Produktion.
Treibe die KI-Frontier: Du folgst der KI-Debatte nicht – du treibst sie. Evals, Prompt-Iteration, Kosten-Qualitäts-Trade-offs in Produktion. Du experimentierst unermüdlich mit dem Möglichen und bringst die Speerspitze ins Produkt.
Sei das Bindegewebe: Du sitzt zwischen Engineering, Steuerberatung und Mandanten und machst die Organisation dadurch schneller. First-Principles-Denken.
Dein Profil
Produkterfahrung: 3–6 Jahre Produktmanagement in B2B-SaaS, FinTech, Finance, Tax oder einem vergleichbar komplexen Umfeld. Du kannst auf Features verweisen, die du von der Vision bis zur messbaren Wirkung verantwortet hast – nicht auf Features, an denen du mitgewirkt hast.
KI-Track-Record: Mindestens ein KI-/LLM-Feature in Produktion ausgeliefert – mit echten Evals, Prompt-Iteration und Verantwortung für Kosten-Qualitäts-Trade-offs. Solides Verständnis moderner LLM-Stacks: RAG, Prompt Engineering, Fine-Tuning vs. In-Context-Learning, Vektor-Stores. ChatGPT-Prompts zählen nicht – wir wollen KI-native Workflows, die du tatsächlich gebaut hast.
Mandanten-Empathie, die sich übersetzt: Echte Empathie für beide Seiten – den Berater unter Fristendruck und den Mandanten, der einfach Sicherheit will – und die Disziplin, diese Empathie in Produktentscheidungen zu übersetzen, nicht in Backlog-Items.
Auge fürs Design: Figma-Souveränität auf Skizzen- und Review-Niveau. Klare Meinungen dazu, wie gute UI aussieht, und null Toleranz für schlampige Interfaces. Begeisterung für Claude Design ist ein Plus.
KI-Begeisterung: Du nutzt KI-Produkte täglich, kritisierst sie öffentlich oder privat und hast scharfe Ansichten dazu, wohin sie sich entwickeln. Praktische Vertrautheit mit Claude Cowork/Design/Code, GPT, Gemini o. Ä. ist die Baseline.
Selbst-Umsetzung: Du wartest nicht darauf, entblockt zu werden. Du prototypst, testest Prompts, verdrahtest Integrationen, hackst zusammen, was nötig ist. Wenn etwas blockiert ist, entblockst du es.
Strukturiertes Denken: MECE, First Principles, hypothesengetrieben. Du verdichtest Ambiguität zu klaren Entscheidungen – nicht zu weiteren Foliensätzen.
Kommunikation: Exzellentes Englisch (C2). Deutsch ist ein starkes Plus.
Domänen-Hintergrund: Erfahrung in Finance, Tax, Accounting oder angrenzenden Domänen ist ein starkes Plus – ebenso Vertrautheit mit Accounting-/Finance-Software-Stacks, DATEV, ELSTER oder regulierten Datenworkflows.

Affinidi is a technology company dedicated to changing data ownership for good. We empower businesses and individuals with control and ownership of their data, with a comprehensive approach to managing their holistic identity – accounting for all aspects of their digital footprint while ensuring privacy and security.
Affinidi’s technology enables users to benefit from decentralised digital identity solutions. We believe that everyone has the right to own and control their data, and we are committed to creating a trusted digital credentials ecosystem that empowers businesses and individuals to securely exchange data and services across borders and industries.
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager (Technical) who wants to help define how trust is built into the next generation of AI systems. At Affinidi, we’re building the Trust Fabric product suite to give AI agents verifiable identity, policy guardrails, and real-time observability, so organisations can move from promising proofs of concept to secure, governed production deployments with confidence.
This is a role for builders. You’ll work side by side with engineering to turn ambitious ideas into real, high-impact products, fast, iteratively, and with strong product judgment. You’ll take on complex, ambiguous challenges that don’t come with a playbook, bring structure to what matters, and help the team move with clarity, speed, and conviction.

You’ll also collaborate with deeply engaged teams and senior leaders in an environment that expects high standards, values ownership, and gives you the chance to shape meaningful products from the ground up.
If you like combining technical depth, product thinking, and execution, you’ll fit right in.
What you’ll be doing
Shape and deliver solutions : Partner closely with engineers to define and refine solutions early, helping move ideas from concept to production in practical, incremental steps while staying close enough to implementation to understand trade-offs and guide decisions.
Drive focused, outcome-oriented delivery: Balance user needs, market context, and execution speed while focusing on getting working solutions into users’ hands for validation, then iterate based on feedback and measurable outcomes.
Work through ambiguity : Take ownership of areas where requirements are not fully defined, structure problems into clear, actionable paths forward, and maintain momentum even as direction continues to evolve.
Own product direction: Contribute to product strategy and roadmap definition, align short-term priorities with longer-term platform thinking, and make thoughtful trade-offs that support both delivery and scalability.
Collaborate across stakeholders : Work across engineering, design, and go-to-market teams, engage effectively with senior and executive stakeholders, and bring alignment and clarity in environments with diverse perspectives.
Be developer-obsessed : Understand developer workflows and key pain points, and help improve integration, usability, and the overall product experience.

Core experience : You bring 5+ years of experience in Technical Product Management, a strong technical background that lets you engage deeply with engineering topics, hands-on experience working with APIs, systems, and integrations, and a proven track record of delivering products in close collaboration with engineering teams.
Technical depth : You are comfortable understanding how systems are designed and operate in practice, able to engage in technical discussions, challenge assumptions, and evaluate trade-offs, and willing to go into detail when needed by reviewing flows, investigating issues, or clarifying implementation approaches.
Mindset : You take ownership from problem to outcome, are comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving priorities, combine structured thinking with a bias toward action, and can move between big-picture strategy and practical execution.
Collaboration & communication : You communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences, are comfortable working with experienced, highly engaged stakeholders, and know how to build alignment and drive decisions forward.
Nice to have : It’s a plus if you have had exposure to identity, distributed systems, or similar domains, and experience in fast-paced, product-led environments.

A team that values ownership, quality, and speed
Close collaboration between product and engineering
Hybrid working model in Berlin + flexible hours
Unlimited vacation

A strong environment to learn, build, and have impact

Team: Product, Research & Design
Prolific
Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.

As we scale our AI Product Group, we're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take founder-level ownership of the tooling that lets frontier AI model developers conduct cutting-edge research on Prolific.

Increasingly, our AI customers are among the leading AI companies in the world, and this role will additionally lead a team of client-facing engineers dedicated to building strategic integrations and rapid, bespoke development for their most demanding needs.

You'll report into the AI Lead, and join a brilliant team of Product Managers building next-generation AI tooling within our AI Product Group.
Impact: You'll be the Product person accountable for the outcomes of a stream-aligned team building next-gen tooling for frontier AI model developers, and also prioritise for impact the work of a client-facing engineering team. This is a career-defining moment to shape how some of the world's biggest technology companies build AI – no big deal. You'll own how our most strategic AI clients experience Prolific end to end, from product to bespoke integration.
Experience: You'll bring experience building AI native systems, with particular experience building AI native UX. You'll have had success taking complex human workflows and distilling them into highly adaptable technical systems, then scaling access to those systems across multiple interaction surfaces – UI, APIs, CLIs, and MCPs.

You'll also have experience directly managing engineers, ideally in a client-facing or solutions-engineering capacity, and know how to turn a sophisticated client's bespoke needs into a scalable integration rather than a one-off fix.
Domain: You will manage two teams which together give you unmatched closeness and opportunity to build tools for the companies and researchers driving the AI frontier. The Data Collection Tooling team is responsible for building and scaling the systems that enable high-quality human data collection for AI training and evaluation.

Additionally the strategic integrations team interfaces directly with our biggest AI accounts for custom builds. It's critical that the person in this role prioritizes both intuitively and systematically, and is a master at the elegant art of trade-offs between the here and now and the future.
Responsibilities: You'll product manage a stream-aligned team of your own, and lead a team of client-facing engineers delivering strategic integrations and rapid, custom development for our most strategic AI accounts. You'll be accountable for the outcomes of both, and be the key driver of interaction with your peer teams, collaborating across domains of science, research, supply, sales, and account services.
Culture: Adding on to our Prolific Principles, we expect colleagues in the Product, Research, and Design Group to demonstrate reliability, grit, diplomacy, a bias for action, and a dogged focus on value – you'll be a champion of these behaviours yourself, and in the culture of your team. Accountability and autonomy are two sides of the same coin, and we expect you to demonstrate both.
What you'll be doing
Build and launch the next generation of Prolific's Data Collection Tooling product suite.
Lead a team of client-facing engineers delivering strategic integrations and rapid, custom development for our most demanding AI accounts.
Stay up to speed with the rapidly changing face of frontier AI research, keeping your product ahead of customer needs.
Run the end-to-end product development lifecycle, from strategy to success metrics to roadmap, delivery, and iteration – communicating that strategy clearly to executives while working through the details with your team.
Be an unblocker and simplifier of complexity: colleagues will bring you problems, and emerge optimistic, with solutions.
Partner productively with Product Design, User Research, Analytics, and Engineering in a test-learn-iterate fashion.

An extensive and varied track record building AI-native products and UX, including scaling access across multiple interaction surfaces such as UI, APIs, CLIs, and MCPs.
Experience directly managing engineers, ideally in a client-facing or solutions-engineering capacity, and turning sophisticated clients' bespoke needs into scalable integrations.
Fluency in modern Product/Engineering practice: Agile, continuous discovery and delivery, JTBD, vertical slicing, test-learn-iterate.
Strong commercial acumen and data-informed decision-making, paired with a storyteller's flair and a relentless can-do attitude.
Even better if you have
Experience building for or with frontier AI labs or major technology companies.
A track record of giving back to your Product community.
Why Prolific is a great place to work
We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.
We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.
Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.

As a Senior Product Manager, you own whether the solution is valuable to customers and viable for the business, working alongside design and engineering, who bring usability and feasibility. This role needs to build strong working relationships across design and engineering and pull in the right partners for the problem at hand.

It also needs a working knowledge of the constraints across marketing, sales, customer success, finance, accounting, legal, and privacy, plus a deep understanding of who our athletes are and how they actually use our products.

That depth comes from genuine curiosity: about the business, about the families and athletes we serve, about the data behind their behavior, and about the technology, including AI, that shapes what's possible for the product.

The best person for this this role builds shared context across the teams around them, and earns trust and rapport with stakeholders, not through authority, but by consistently showing up with the right questions and the right evidence. This role sits at the bleeding edge of solving problems for families navigating the college recruiting process.

The decisions made here will shape the experience for thousands of families, and in some cases change the course of a young athlete's life. It's an individual contributor role, accountable for solving real problems for customers in a way that works for the business, not just shipping a list of features.

Success here is measured by the outcomes we create for athletes and families, and by how those outcomes move the business forward.

Execute against and help inform the product vision and strategy for the Core Athlete experience, translating it into a roadmap where each phase of work builds on the one before it, not just a queue of features. Foster shared understanding of that vision and strategy across your team and stakeholders.
Build and maintain deep, current knowledge of the business, our athletes and families, the data behind their behavior, and the technology behind our products, and use that knowledge to spot the right problems early.
Own the backlog. Write user stories and acceptance criteria that make the “why” clear, not just the “what.”
Partner with design and engineering, and pull in the right people across the business, to move from discovery to delivery.
Run experiments to test solutions before betting the roadmap on them. Feasibility and usability get tested early, not discovered late.
Track industry trends and the competitive landscape in athlete recruiting, and bring that context back to the team.
Stay fluent in AI as it evolves. Spot where it can change the product for athletes and families, and use it to speed up your own research, analysis, and daily workflow.
Build trust and rapport with stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, Operations, and Support. Use data and a clear narrative, not just authority, to align people around decisions.
Stay accountable for the metrics behind the roadmap, not just the delivery schedule.

5+ years of product management experience, ideally including consumer-facing or user-facing products on a sprint-based, cross-functional team.
Demonstrated ability to run product discovery: framing problems, testing solutions with real users, and killing ideas that don't hold up.
Working SQL skills. You should be comfortable pulling and interpreting your own data rather than waiting on someone else's report.
Experience partnering directly with engineers and designers as peers to move ideas from discovery to delivery.
Genuine curiosity about the business, the customer, the data, and the technology, and the judgment to know which one matters most for a given problem.
AI fluency: comfortable using AI tools day to day, and sharp enough about what AI can and can't do to spot where it genuinely changes the product.
A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-functional problems into a clear, prioritized backlog.
Proven track record of translating complex business needs into clear product strategies and roadmaps.
Exceptional communication and storytelling skills. You should be able to write a one-page narrative that convinces a skeptical exec, and influence and align senior stakeholders, not just present a slide deck that restates numbers.
Highly self-motivated and resourceful, comfortable leading both strategy and execution.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
Comfortable holding a position and defending it with data, while staying genuinely open to being wrong.

As a Product Manager for the Core Apps domain, you will contribute to shaping the systems and capabilities that power FanDuel's customer-facing mobile and web applications. These applications serve millions of users across major sporting events, delivering seamless sports betting experiences to customers.

In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional product development teams to evolve critical customer facing capabilities and optimise performance of the app.

You will collaborate with engineering and product engineering pillars to ensure our apps remain robust, adaptable, and innovative, supporting new product features, market expansions, and evolving regulatory and commercial needs.

This is an impactful role that will benefit from both technical understanding and product management skills — you'll contribute to optimizing app performance, building enabling capabilities that allow our product engineering teams to move at speed, and help ensure FanDuel continues to deliver seamless, high-volume betting experiences through our customer-facing applications.

Own and deliver feature-level outcomes over quarters, executing within established initiatives.
Contribute to strategies and propose solutions that address customer problems.
Support defining success criteria for features; gather insights through analytics, research, and competitive analysis.
Participate in shaping activities (e.g., spikes, usability testing, A/B tests) to de-risk features and refine solutions that enhance app capabilities.
Execute appropriate delivery approaches (experiment, MVP, data-driven) to achieve outcomes that enable faster product engineering delivery.
Coordinate cross-team dependencies; communicate progress, blockers, and impacts to stakeholders and senior product managers.
Support collaborative workshops (ideation, unpacking, requirements gathering) and help ensure clear action plans for app improvement initiatives.
Build technical understanding in your product area; apply feasibility insights during solution development.

2-3 years of digital product management experience with demonstrable feature-level delivery and outcomes, preferably with mobile or web application focus.
Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with metrics, analyzing data, and recommending improvements.
Experience facilitating workshops, design sprints, and cross-team planning sessions.
Ability to balance tactical execution with strategic thinking.
Understanding of customer needs and behaviours , gained through research and cross-functional collaboration in consumer-facing applications.
Technical aptitude; ability to understand trade-offs and collaborate effectively with Engineering teams.
Experience working in fast-paced, data-driven environments with multiple stakeholders.

Belonging - everyone at FanDuel works for each other, we win together, make mistakes together and have lots of fun doing it.
Trust - A trusting work environment where productivity is valued above all else, giving you autonomy and ownership of your time and work
Great financial package - Including salary, bonus, pension, private healthcare, share save scheme, flexible working & holiday policy along with a number of other benefits.

TL;DR — alago brings AI-powered project management to the construction industry. As our Product Manager , you'll own a core product area end to end: how messy project data becomes an early warning that a €200M project is about to go wrong. Full-time, Munich.
About alago
Imagine if building a building were as easy as building software. Every moving part visible, every change traceable, every decision still carrying its reasoning six months later.
Software got there by making its own history legible — every commit, every diff. Construction never did. A €200M project runs on plan sets nobody can diff and decisions buried in email, so the same mistakes happen over and over, and the industry loses $1.6 trillion a year to it.
That's what we're fixing. Eleven people, 15+ customers, €1M+ pre-seed from leading construction-tech VCs and one of Germany's largest project developers. The product is live and used daily on real construction sites — which means the interesting work is only starting.
Tasks

Translate deeply technical construction workflows into decisions engineers can build from
Own a product area end to end: From discovery on site to shipped, instrumented, measured features
Shape the roadmap: Balance what the next customer needs against the foundations that make the next ten cheap
Make the hard prioritization calls on scope and sequencing, and defend them
Define what "working" means: pick the metrics, instrument them, read production data, iterate
Treat LLM behavior as a product problem, not a research one — evals, fallbacks, and what the user sees when the model is wrong

Must-haves
2+ years shipping product — as a product manager, or as a UI/product designer who's been making product calls and not just screens
You've shipped something where the hard part was the data model, not the button
Hands-on experience with LLM-powered features in production — you know what breaks and how users react when it does
Genuine willingness to put on boots and go on site until you know the domain better than we do
Bonus
AEC background
Founder experience, or product work at a company under 20 people
You already build your own agents and internal tools to do your job faster
Not a match on every line? Apply anyway — potential and learning curve count.

You'll be one of our first product hires, which means you own critical parts of the product end to end and work directly with the founders. It's early enough that you help decide how the company works, and the path from here goes to either top individual contributor or leading product as we grow, depending on where you're strongest.

Hybrid: three days a week in our central Munich office (WERK1).
Plus: Wellpass, team dinners twice a week, relocation support.

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to be the primary product voice for Elastic Security's most strategic enterprise customers. Solid products are built on a clear knowledge of real customer needs. In large enterprise accounts, those needs arrive as a constant stream of enhancement requests, feature asks, and hard problems.

They often arrive faster than any one team can act on them. Someone has to bring order to that stream, tell apart what a customer wants from what a customer needs, and turn it into a coherent product direction across different product areas.
In this high-impact role, you will own the relationship between Elastic Security's product organization and our most strategic enterprise accounts. You will manage enhancement requests across many enterprise customers at once.

You will prioritize them with judgment and data, and make sure they keep transitioning through the system instead of sitting idle.

You will be the person a CISO trusts in the room, the person an engineering lead respects for the quality of your requirements, and the person who can tell a major customer that something will not be built without losing the relationship.

You will work at the intersection of Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering, building the structure that lets Elastic scale close customer relationships without simply adding headcount.
What You Will Be Doing
Own the enhancement request pipeline across multiple strategic enterprise accounts at once. Build and maintain a structured system to track, prioritize, and respond to customer-sourced requirements, and keep requests moving rather than leaving them in “under consideration.”
Translate customer requirements into shipped products. Work at the level of customer pain, not just the feature that was asked for, and synthesize input from many accounts into a single, coherent product direction.
Turn input from strategic accounts into successful products. Look for patterns across accounts. Shape some of these patterns into formal partnerships for design. Make sure the resulting capabilities benefit the wider market, not just the single customer that made the request.
Feed validated customer patterns back into the core product roadmaps, influencing direction well beyond the accounts you cover.
Serve as the primary product voice in meetings with senior customer stakeholders, including the CISO, CTO, and VP of Security Operations. Deliver roadmap updates, including deprioritizations and misses, in a way that keeps the relationship deep.
Prioritize customer-sourced requirements using structured frameworks such as RICE, weighted scoring, and opportunity sizing. Use data where it is available and clear judgment where it is thin, and be transparent about which is which.
Partner with product and engineering leads to write requirements they can act on without follow-up clarification meetings. Understand system architecture well enough to assess feasibility and scope on your own.
Operate across Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Legal. Support deal cycles as a product resource through RFP responses, security questionnaires, and roadmap presentations to prospects.
Navigate tension between a customer's contractual expectations and the internal roadmap , and tackle it directly rather than through routine escalation.
Create artifacts such as roadmap trackers, enhancement request dashboards, and decision memos that give customers and internal stakeholders visibility without requiring a meeting.
Advocate for customer needs inside the company while resisting the pull of the loudest or largest customer setting the roadmap at the expense of the broader market.

Extensive Experience: 7–10 years of product management experience, with at least 4 years in B2B enterprise software. A consistent record of owning a product area with meaningful revenue impact and of leading products from customer input through shipped, iterated outcomes. Direct experience working with named strategic accounts, not only through customer success proxies. Experience with hyperscalers, MSSPs and/or PubSec is a solid plus.
Security Domain Knowledge: Hands-on knowledge with SIEM, SOAR, XDR or broader security operations platforms, either as a product manager or as a practitioner such as a SOC analyst, detection engineer, or security architect.

You can credibly discuss detection engineering, log ingestion pipelines, correlation rules, threat hunting workflows, and compliance use cases without a solutions engineer in the room. You understand the difference between what a CISO wants to hear and what a SOC analyst actually needs.

A background as a security practitioner, such as SOC, incident response, or detection engineering, before moving into product is a solid plus, and brings credibility that is hard to teach.
Enhancement Request Management at Scale: You have personally run a structured enhancement request pipeline across several enterprise accounts at the same time. You can step into a relationship with dozens of open requests and no prior documentation and build a working tracking system within weeks.
Executive Presence: You are comfortable as the primary product voice with C-suite and VP-level customer stakeholders. You can deliver difficult news without losing the relationship, and you can hold both the executive view and the analyst view in the same meeting.
Technical Credibility: You earn respect from engineering through the quality of your requirements rather than through authority. You write specs engineers can act on, and you know enough about architecture to judge feasibility and scope.
Cross-functional Leadership and Influence: You have operated at the intersection of Product, Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Legal, and you know which function owns what and how to advance work across all of them. You lead across a matrixed organization, align multiple stakeholders toward a common vision, and drive execution in a dynamic, remote-first environment, with the autonomy and judgment expected of a principal-level product leader.
Structured Thinking and Bias for Closure: You bring order to unstructured problems, using data to prioritize and clear judgment when data is thin, and staying transparent about which is which. You move work through the system and follow up proactively rather than waiting to be asked, defaulting to visibility through artifacts instead of meetings. You advocate for customer needs while synthesizing them into product direction rather than relaying demands.

From there, your scope extends across the internal tools that support the wider acquisition engine: marketing automation, reporting and analytics workflows, creative operations, and the new tooling we build as the business shifts.

We expect the exact portfolio to evolve, and we are hiring someone who wants that rather than someone looking for a single fixed product.
This is a hands-on builder role rather than a coordination role. Your users are colleagues, the feedback loop is short, and your work shows up in CPA, ROAS, wasted spend, and hours returned to the team. You will report to the Head of Product and work daily with Engineering, Data, Media Buying, Creative, and Operations.

1. Product Strategy & Roadmap
Own the end-to-end roadmap for the Media Buyer Automation Platform, including discovery, prioritization, specifications, delivery, adoption, and iteration.
Take on additional internal products as the portfolio grows, sequencing work across marketing automation, reporting and analytics, creative operations, cross-platform account management, and data reconciliation while maintaining focus on the core platform.
2. User Needs & Automation
Work closely with media buyers to understand their workflows and translate their operational needs into reliable automation for budget pacing, anomaly alerts, spend guardrails, bulk actions, and approval flows.
Identify manual processes that are consuming capacity across the business and evaluate whether they should be automated through internal development, external solutions, or left unchanged.
3. Product Development & Delivery
Write clear product specifications that engineers can build from, including edge cases, failure modes, rollback behavior, and a defined bar for completion.
Prototype ideas and build lightweight automations where this can accelerate alignment or address smaller workflow needs without relying on the engineering roadmap.
4. Adoption, Measurement & Collaboration
Drive product adoption through onboarding, enablement, documentation, and continuous feedback loops that ensure tools remain actively used and valuable.
Define and track meaningful product metrics, ensuring they are properly instrumented and visible, while partnering with Data on event taxonomy, attribution challenges, and measurement trade-offs.
5. Experimentation & Optimization
Run experiments and staged rollouts to validate changes, particularly for functionality that affects advertising spend, before deploying them across full budgets.
Continuously evaluate and iterate on products based on performance data, user feedback, and evolving business needs.

4+ years in Product Management, with 2+ years owning data-heavy or workflow-heavy products end-to-end.
Proven track record of building internal or B2B tools for colleagues and driving high adoption.
Skilled in KPI design, event taxonomy, dashboarding, and turning numbers into decisions.
Active use of AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, n8n, custom scripts) to build prototypes and automate workflows. (Examples will be requested).
Practical understanding of LLM limitations, probabilistic feature evaluation, and fallback logic.
Comfortable running multiple workstreams at once and making confident calls on what to ship first.
Strong track record of launching small, frequent releases rather than big-bang updates.
Excellent written/verbal English—creates clear specs, explicit trade-offs, and transparent status updates.
Experience collaborating effectively across global time zones.
Nice-to-Haves
Experience with paid acquisition platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok), rules engines, budget pacing, or creative testing workflows.
Computer Science, Computer Engineering degree, or experience managing complex SaaS products with multi-platform API integrations.
Hands-on experience with A/B testing frameworks, feature flagging, or staged rollout systems for spend-affecting logic.

Yubico is a global leader in identity security and creator of the YubiKey, the original hardware-backed passkey. We are publicly traded on Nasdaq Stockholm; our global footprint includes headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, Silicon Valley, California; and Singapore.

At Yubico, we are guided by a shared belief that your work matters. We operate under a cultural philosophy of Speed with Integrity , pushing the boundaries of technology to secure the AI frontier—protecting both human and agentic AI interactions—and leading the transition to post-quantum cryptography. In everything we do, we live by our core values:
Battle Friction: We constantly look for new ways to simplify our products, our work, and the user experience.
Inspire Higher: We think big, champion the open internet, and strive to do the right thing even when it is difficult.
One Team: We are open, responsive, and collaborative, overcoming challenges and celebrating our successes together.
Aligned with our commitment to open standards, we foster a thriving builder ecosystem through the Yubico Developer Program , offering free open-source repositories , libraries, and SDKs to help developers rapidly integrate strong hardware authentication into any application.

Through close collaborations with technical partners like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, as well as newer frontiers like OpenAI, we continue to shape a safer digital world while donating security keys to protect vulnerable communities, journalists, and humanitarian groups worldwide through our Secure it Forward program.

Yubico Values: We work to ensure that our employees have an open space to have their voices amplified to create a workplace where everyone feels like they belong. In support of this, our employees have created some pretty cool Employee Resource Groups that foster inclusion, help build community and connection across Yubico. Additionally, Yubico donates YubiKeys to organizations in need all over the world (you can read more about our work here ).
Social Connection: Relationships and connectedness matter, and we love spending time with our team! Our virtual workspace keeps us connected day-to-day whether it's through Yubico celebrating wins or our buzzing Slack communities. Check out our Life at Yubico Page on LinkedIn and our awards here .

Product Manager, Safety & Compliance
CreatorIQ is the software enterprise brands and agencies use to run their creator marketing programs. Customers include Burson, Delta Air Lines, Google, LVMH, Nestlé and Sephora. Those programs only hold up if the content is brand safe, sponsorships are disclosed, the music is cleared, and every campaign follows the rules in the markets it runs in. You'll own the product that makes that happen.
The core is SafeIQ, our always-on brand safety system. It runs multimodal AI classification on audio, video, images and text across millions of creator posts, and flags risk before it becomes a headline.
If you like turning messy classification and regulatory problems into workflows that risk, legal and compliance teams trust, you'll fit in. We're growing fast, and we work with teams around the world who care about doing great work.

s.h: In this role, you’ll get to
s.t:
Own the in-app brand safety review and workflow experience end to end, with one goal: shorten the path from "AI flagged something" to "a human made a confident decision." Ship, measure, learn, repeat.
Decide how AI classification reaches people: severity, categories, thresholds, review states and false-positive handling. Work with data science on what the models look for across audio, video, images and text, how confident they need to be before surfacing something, and where a human stays in the loop. Make every flag explainable and auditable.
Own compliance beyond content risk: sponsorship and ad disclosure under FTC guidelines and their equivalents, music licensing and rights clearance, legal drinking age (LDA) rules for alcohol promotion, and GDPR and regional privacy requirements. Work with Legal, Trust & Safety and regional compliance stakeholders to stay ahead of regulatory change without making every workflow wait on a legal review.
Understand the business nuance for API contracts, webhook payloads and data models with engineering so customers can pull safety and compliance signals into their own systems.
Work with GTM on positioning, packaging and enablement so what we sell matches what the product does and what regulators require.

s.h: Who you are and what you’ll need for this position
s.t:
You've spent 4+ years in product management or equivalent technical product ownership in B2B SaaS. Titles matter less than the work.
You have good product taste. You can look at an AI-generated feature or output and tell good UX from an AI slop, and you can say why.
You think critically and independently. You don't take a model's output, a legal requirement, a stakeholder request or a roadmap item at face value.
You can turn a dense, ambiguous regulatory or licensing requirement into a workflow engineers can build, and write it up clearly without needing a meeting.
You know the basics of AI classification pipelines: inference, confidence thresholds, false positives and negatives, and human review. You don't have to build them.
You're comfortable with API contracts, webhooks and role-based access well enough to write requirements with engineers.
You care more about solving real user problems, like getting a risk team to zero backlog with confidence, than about shipping features for their own sake.
You're curious, self-driven and low-ego. You own the product end to end, don't wait to be told what's next, and are allergic to "that's not my job."
You're comfortable working with distributed teams. Most work is async and flexible, but occasionally we'll ask for a later call. Stakeholders for this role are distributed across NA, EU, and APAC timezones
